title: 欧洲航天追赶：卫星强但发射弱，能追上美中吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You are watching Blue Bogota Europe coming up, the hype around SpaceX's historic IPO made it the hottest ticket on Wall Street and proof that the US dominates the race for space.
segments.zh: 欢迎收看《蓝色波哥大·欧洲》。SpaceX历史性IPO引发热潮，成为华尔街最热门标的，也证明美国在太空竞赛中占据主导地位。

segments.en: Europe's space industry meanwhile might lag well behind both America and China, but it's not backing down as it pursues its own path to space autonomy.
segments.zh: 与此同时，欧洲航天业可能远落后于美国和中国，但并未退缩，正寻求自主发展太空能力。

segments.en: Those involved in the mission say success will require an all-hands effort from Europe.
segments.zh: 参与任务的人士表示，成功需要欧洲全体动员。

segments.en: We see now of course with the IPO of SpaceX that the support of NASA and the Space Force really leads to world dominating space companies.
segments.zh: 我们看到，SpaceX的IPO表明，NASA和太空部队的支持确实催生了全球领先的太空公司。

segments.en: And this is something of course where volume is just as important as excellence.
segments.zh: 当然，在这一点上，规模与卓越同样重要。

segments.en: We speak to European companies and policy makers leading efforts to develop the homegrown space economy, including LNUB from the exploration company, the head of the European Space Agency.
segments.zh: 我们采访了推动本土太空经济发展的欧洲企业和政策制定者，包括探索公司LNUB、欧洲航天局局长，以及Pulse Star Fusion和Bioorbits的CEO。

segments.en: And the chief executives of Pulse Star Fusion and Bioorbits. Welcome to Blue Bogota, Europe.
segments.zh: 欢迎收看《蓝色波哥大·欧洲》。
